mapper.insert: insert into T_MDM_PRODUCTION_MOLDING(year, month, product_code, construction_code, factory_code, molding_machine_code, mould_method, CREATE_BY) select distinct #{generateYear}, #{generateMonth}, tmmppf.PRODUCT_CODE, tmmppf.construction_code, tmmppf.factory_code, tmmppf.molding_machine_code, tmmmc.mould_method, #{username} from t_mp_month_plan_vulcanizing_final tmmppf left join T_MDM_MOLDING_MACHINE tmmm on tmmm.id = tmmppf.MOLDING_MACHINE_ID left join T_MDM_MOLDING_MACHINE_CLS tmmmc on tmmmc.id = tmmm.MOLDING_MACHINE_CLASS_ID where tmmppf.IS_DELETE = 0 and tmmppf.YEAR = #{fromYear} and tmmppf.month = #{fromMonth} and tmmppf.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} and IFNULL(tmmppf.${productionDayField}, 0) > 0
